title: A dragged gallery selection reaches the agent as ONE set chip
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-941 - In-app agent umbrella 2 (consolidation sweep 2026-09-27). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-941/plan.md. Phase 2 there. Shape: a drag that starts on a selected card carries the whole selection in click order; the chat shows ONE layers chip "N cards"; the agent gets one set:<id> handle that generate cards expands (refs, never pixels), then MPI-941 Phase 1 runs it as one job. No selection-bar button unless testers miss the drag.
